project: Wuxia Life P105 Merchant Martial Patron Pressure Design-First
description: Design-first contract stage for merchant_martial_patron pressure phase — define pressure direction, contract, and validation shape before implementation, preserving 商武一体 flavor and magnate/renown distinction.

userStories.title: Audit patron pressure prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the patron pressure stage so P105 starts from the real gating surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize existing patron route flags, markers, events, and expressions (P102 native + P103/P104 bridge-origin + payoff echo)
Identify what exists before pressure vs what can be reused
Compare magnate_midlife_pressure and renown_midlife_pressure precedents
Save docs/test-reports/p105-merchant-martial-patron-pressure-prerequisite-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Prerequisite audit saved — patron on-ramp flags/events/expressions mapped; magnate+renown pressure precedents compared; GAP-P104-N01/N02 confirmed.

userStories.title: Lock P105 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P105 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P105 to gap audit, direction comparison, pressure contract, and proof shape only
Define allowed layers: documentation, contract, targeted proof planning
List forbidden expansions: runtime wiring, P102-P104 rewrite, magnate spine rewrite, payoff redesign, new UI
Save docs/test-reports/p105-merchant-martial-patron-pressure-scope-contract.md
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Compare patron pressure directions
userStories.description: As a designer, I want bounded pressure-direction options so P105 chooses the smallest viable pressure shape before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare at least 2 pressure direction candidates (e.g. martial-backers burden, sect favor-debt, merchant-martial identity split)
Each candidate includes: core narrative, trigger conditions, player choice space, distinction from magnate/renown pressure
Select recommended direction and document rejected alternatives
Recommendation follows quality-first and small-step principles
Save comparison document under docs/test-reports/
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define patron pressure contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit pressure contract so P106 knows exactly what flags, gates, events, and player-facing meanings must be closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Define pressure checkpoint, required flags, and corresponding gate acceptance
Define 1 core pressure event (or 1 tightly coupled event group)
Define at least 2 pressure-specific player-facing signals
Clarify difference between pressure vs on-ramp and vs magnate midlife pressure
Preserve native/bridge-origin variant expression priority rules
Reserve flag interfaces for subsequent payoff/late-life stages
Save contract to docs/PRD/p105-merchant-martial-patron-pressure-contract.md
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define P106 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P106 validation shape fixed in advance so playable pressure work is judged against explicit expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Define which chain nodes targeted proof must show (on-ramp → pressure → expression changes)
Define which assertions regression tests must cover at minimum (P102-P104 patron + P97-P101 magnate)
Define what evidence counts as pressure closed
No full lifetime exhaust required
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Produce P105 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the patron pressure design-first contract and hands off to P106.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p105-merchant-martial-patron-pressure-closure-report.md
Summarize prerequisite audit, scope contract, pressure-direction comparison, pressure contract, validation shape
Clarify boundary with P106
List remaining deferred larger patron-expansion items
State GO / NO-GO for pressure implementation stage
npm run typecheck passes
